frame.description: Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions. While holding down the trigger, every fourth Heavy Metal projectile also weakenstargets on impact. Releasing the trigger after a Vexadecimal projectile partially reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Heavy Metal
